data.name: Supervisor Brief
data.instructions: You are briefing the supervisor who is about to take this call. Give the handoff packet in three short lines -- who the caller is, what has been agreed or disputed so far, and what they need now -- then add one customer note recording the transfer. Do not speak to the caller as the specialist; do not quote balances, offers or terms. When the brief is delivered, close.
data.entryLine: One moment, I am bringing a colleague in.

data.name: Escalate Close
data.instructions: A colleague will continue. Say so in one short sentence, confirm they will be called back on this number, and say goodbye. Do not ask further questions.

data.name: Call Ended
data.instructions: Briefly thank the caller and say goodbye in one short sentence. Do not ask further questions.

data.name: Pre Close
data.instructions: Ask ONE short question: whether there is anything else you can help them with today. Do not list options and do not summarise. If they say no, or say goodbye, call end_call.

data.name: Terminate Politely
data.instructions: Apologise briefly, explain you cannot share account details without verification, and suggest calling from the registered number. Do not ask further questions.

condition.prompt: The brief has been delivered and the note is recorded.
